name: geothermal_steam_turbine
title: Geothermal hot water driving a steam turbine (exercise)
summary: Geothermal water at 1.5 MPa and 180 °C is throttled into a flash evaporator at 400 kPa. Saturated vapour expands to 10 kPa and a quality of 0.9. For a turbine power of 1000 kW the model computes the steam flow and the hourly source flow.
